{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
